plainTranslation: Their Sun in your 3rd house: they light up your daily life and thinking; easy talk, a lively everyday connection. Failure mode: all surface chatter, no depth. Enjoy the spark; let it go somewhere.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
